description:
Validates workflow YAML/JSON files for correctness.

Checks:
- Valid YAML/JSON syntax
- Interpolation references (${step.output}, ${variable}) point to valid steps/variables
- Tool names exist and are enabled in tools.config.json
- No circular dependencies in step execution order
- Variable names follow snake_case convention

Returns detailed error messages with suggestions for fixing issues.

format.description: Output format: "text" for human-readable, "json" for structured data

isJson.description: Set to true if the content is JSON instead of YAML

workflowContent.description: The YAML or JSON content of the workflow to validate

name: validate_workflow
